description: An order's report as Markdown (report), when ready is true: a free check's (with next: where an agent would probably stop, how many things to fix, whether it can be listed, whether an Audit fits, and the driven products in its category), or an Audit's drive's for a verified owner of the domain, with payment_map when the drive paid. Not ready yet: ready false, state (queued, running, late, retrying, failed or final_check), why in plain words and when to ask again (check_eta). A free check of a domain you proved opens too, whoever ran it. An unpaid order answers not_paid with where to pay; a data plan has no report.
